props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole graph after every change, including each step of a node drag.

props.name: isCompatible
props.description: Whether an output type may feed an input type. Defaults to equal types, or either side being `any`.

props.name: allowCycles
props.description: Allow wires that close a loop. Off by default: most node graphs are evaluated in order and a loop never ends.

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Width of every node in pixels.

props.name: wheelZoom
props.description: Zoom with the wheel. Turn it off inside a scrolling page if it fights the scroll.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a height here.
